Figure 3:Standalone PanBase versus classical fusion at RR.PAN- and MS-aligned PanBase are compared with CS/MRA/VO methods
without neural refinement.Redboxes mark enlarged regions; scores are PSNR (dB),
and insets show reconstruction errors.
Unseen WV2 reuses WV3-calibrated coefficients.

Figure 4:Qualitative results before and after PanBase integration.Each pair compares an original backbone with its PanBase-augmented
version. WV3/QB rows show RR results with ground-truth references,
PSNR, and error insets; GF2/WV2 rows show FR results with PAN
references and HQNR. Red boxes mark enlarged regions.
Unseen WV2 uses WV3-trained models and coefficients.

images.caption: Figure 7:Backbone reconstructions on WV3 at reduced resolution.Each column pairs the original and PanBase outputs with their absolute error maps for two scenes. Scores are PSNR in dB. The reference column identifies the crop and shows the HRMS, interpolated LRMS, and PAN images.

Figure 8:Backbone reconstructions on QB at reduced resolution.Each column pairs the original and PanBase outputs with their absolute error maps for two scenes. Scores are PSNR in dB. The HRMS column marks the crop used for comparison.

Figure 9:Backbone reconstructions on GF2 at reduced resolution.Each column pairs the original and PanBase outputs with their absolute error maps for two scenes. Scores are PSNR in dB. In the upper scene, MutInf improves from 37.21 to 44.83 dB with smaller errors around the bright roofs.

Figure 10:Backbone reconstructions on unseen WV2 at reduced resolution.Each column pairs the original and PanBase outputs with their absolute error maps for two scenes. Scores are PSNR in dB. The models and calibration coefficients come from WV3. The upper scene shows BNNPan improving from 25.42 to 28.55 dB.

Figure 11:Residual bases before neural refinement.Each crop shows the observed PAN, interpolated LRMS, PanBase, and reference HRMS. The scores compare the two bases against HRMS in dB. The examples cover GF2, QB, WV3, and unseen WV2.

Figure 12:Standalone reconstruction on four reduced-resolution scenes.Each sensor panel compares the two PanBase geometries with 12 classical methods. The HRMS and interpolated LRMS provide references. Insets show reconstruction errors, and scores give per-scene PSNR in dB.

Figure 13:Additional scenes for standalone fusion.In the GF2 panel, PAN- and MS-aligned PanBase reach 37.11 and 38.66 dB. In the unseen WV2 panel, they reach 29.67 and 29.66 dB using coefficients calibrated on WV3. Insets show the corresponding errors against HRMS.
